full_GO.exactRequestRule: Use the frozen complete JSON request exactly. Only original template args[7] actual binding and args[10] actual prepare-result SHA were substituted; key, executable, flags, source, paths and timeout are unchanged.
full_GO.admission: Persist exact whole request and an independent external Git START intent before the single process_start. Immediately preserve complete original ACK SDK before parsing, verify exact native digest/fingerprint and original returned job; archive ACK and binding before the first observer. Any missing ACK/error/UNKNOWN stops new admissions; no business replay, alternate key or replacement job.

observations.otherLane: A collecting original Mac AuthBus full-worker failure and later separately scoped repair

fixedPublicResultRead.gate: After the one original job has a definitive durable full terminal authority and complete stdout/stderr, and stdout identifies exactly this fixed path and a 64-hex SHA256 with literal_scan_hits=0, read this public file once. A definitive product failure or product outcome_unknown still permits this fixed evidence read; it does not permit another business run. Native tool/RPC uncertainty or a withheld public-evidence pointer stops new read admissions.

file_info.required_sha256: Exactly the original terminal stdout result_sha256; never a guessed hash.

binary_read.offsets: Contiguous from zero to actual file_info size, each original offset admitted once.
binary_read.expected_version: Exactly the original file_info version, unchanged on every range.
required_checks: EOF only at exact actual size
whole size and SHA256 equal original stdout and file_info

archivalProtocol.exactOriginalSDKBeforeAnyParsing: Immediately write and fsync every complete original SDK representation to its local durable journal, preserving embedded native raw text losslessly. A local persistence failure stops admissions. Then inspect isError and parse losslessly.
archivalProtocol.sameObserverPages: Continue only the already returned original operation_id and exact immutable offsets, one call at a time. Do not replay the native read. Each completed observer's original request/ACK/status/pages/payload/native copies are archived as one Git content-tree batch with full SHA/byte readbacks before admitting the next observer.
archivalProtocol.error: On any native tool/RPC/error/missing ACK/UNKNOWN, stop new native admissions, retain and archive all already received original bytes, and reconcile only already returned original observers. Git archival repair may recover identical bytes only and never triggers a native retry.

full_GO.localFsyncYieldRule: A local exec session_id with no exit code is an ongoing fsync, not failure. Persist and poll that same local session to natural terminal; do not re-execute the original write or remote request. Only true nonzero/transport errors stop admissions pending original recovery.
full_GO.postRun: Deliver original authority, whole stdout/stderr, exact public result/metadata/version, all original observer closure, reached cases, actual body complete/EOS/audit outcomes, cleanup and original deadline. Then root independently qualifies. CLI live awaits a distinct GO.
